items.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Federal Civilian Sales
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Federal Civilian Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across federal civilian agencies. You'll leverage your deep understanding of federal civilian operations and consultative sales expertise to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to customers, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities. In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll help refine our approach to the federal civilian market while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance. Responsibilities: Drive new business and revenue growth specifically within federal civilian agencies, owning the full sales cycle from initial outreach through deployment Navigate the unique requirements of federal civilian procurement, including FAR compliance, security standards, and agency-specific regulations Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across federal civilian agencies, becoming a trusted advisor on AI capabilities and implementation Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with agency missions and modernization initiatives Coordinate closely with cloud service providers (AWS, GCP) and system integrators to ensure successful deployment and integration Provide detailed market intelligence and customer feedback to product teams to ensure our offerings meet federal civilian requirements Create and maintain sales playbooks specific to federal civilian use cases and procurement processes Take a leadership role in growing our federal civilian presence while maintaining hands-on engagement with key accounts Collaborate across teams to ensure coordinated delivery of commitments and maintain appropriate documentation of customer engagements You may be a good fit if you have: 8+ years of enterprise sales experience in the federal civilian space, with a proven track record of driving adoption of emerging technologies A deep understanding of federal civilian agency missions, challenges, and technology needs Demonstrated the ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on sales execution Experience navigating complex federal procurement processes and compliance requirements A strong track record of exceeding revenue targets in the federal civilian space Extensive experience with federal civilian contracting vehicles and procurement mechanisms Excellent relationship-building skills across all levels, from technical teams to senior agency leadership A proven ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, including cloud providers and system integrators Strategic thinking combined with attention to detail in execution A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in government contexts Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $380,000 — $450,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter founding Account Executive in Singapore who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals 2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency 3. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends 4. Demonstrate expertise—or a strong willingness to learn—about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more Requirements - 7-10 years of sales experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API platforms - Experience selling technical solutions to product, engineering, or innovation teams is a strong plus - Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment - Expertise or willingness to learn everything about voice and audio AI and how our solutions can help prospects - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization - A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale - Fluency in English and one of the SEA languages (e.g. Bahasa Melayu, Thai, or Tagalog) and a deep understanding of business, cultural, and buying nuances across Southeast Asia - Experience selling across multiple Asian markets (Southeast Asia/ASEAN ) is strongly preferred. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We provide liquidity algorithmically across all major cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms, a broad range of OTC trading solutions as well as support high profile blockchain projects and traditional financial institutions moving into crypto. Wintermute is not just a trading company, it is one the most prominent and influential players in the digital asset markets: we are connected and partnering with all major players in the industry, we actively participate in the development of the blockchain ecosystem through investments, partnerships, and incubation of projects. You can read more here. Working at Wintermute Wintermute is a global company with offices in London and Singapore. It opened its US office in early 2025 and it is set to grow significantly over the next several years. It’s a unique opportunity to play a role in the early rapid expansion of Wintermute Americas. Business Development at Wintermute We are looking for a Business Development Associate to drive growth for our two core business lines: OTC and liquidity provisioning. We are looking for a candidate with experience and/or passion for crypto markets, who is ready and excited to make a big impact for Wintermute. You will be responsible for acquiring new counterparties and partners globally, as well as cultivating and growing Wintermute's existing counterparties with a focus on the United States market. You will be responsible for a set of opportunities (a specific market, vertical, and/or product) and will own these opportunities from end-to-end. You will establish your own strategic growth agenda, supported by structured guidance from leadership in Wintermute’s US and global offices. We offer the market’s leading liquidity products, partner with top-tier blockchain products, and have a strong pipeline of strategic growth opportunities and inbound counterparty demand. We have no legacy processes, no corporate bureaucracy, no multiple levels of approvals, and the highest standards of professionalism. items.title: Stage - Growth Marketing & Operations F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, leader européen des paris sportifs, est bien plus qu’un simple site de jeux en ligne. Proposant également du Poker, des courses hippiques et des jeux de Casino dans plusieurs pays et continents, c’est une entreprise inspirante et tournée vers l’avenir. Chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis dans un environnement moderne et dynamique. Acteur influent de la tech, avec une croissance forte et continue au fil des années, nous croyons en l’innovation grâce à la diversité et à l’inclusion et encourageons chacun à exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Avec notre équipe multiculturelle, nous offrons une expérience de jeu optimale, sûre et responsable, soutenue par une technologie de pointe. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Chez Betclic, le succès repose sur des équipes passionnées et engagées. Voici pourquoi vous aimerez travailler avec nous: 💡 Un environnement international et créatif où chaque projet est une opportunité d’innover 📈 Une hypercroissance qui apporte chaque jour de nouveaux défis et opportunités de développement 🏡 Un bon équilibre vie pro et vie perso avec du télétravail flexible et une attention particulière au bien-être 🌟 Une ambiance unique et conviviale avec 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux Vous êtes passionné de sport et de tech? Rejoignez nous et participez à façonner l’avenir du jeu en ligne. ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que stagiaire au sein de l'équipe Growth - Casino , vous reporterez au Casino Growth Manager. Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir les dynamiques d’un environnement international au rythme soutenu tout en contribuant à des initiatives marketing à fort impact et en développant vos compétences en marketing digital et Ops. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené à: Contribuer à la préparation et au déploiement d’activations marketing destinées à développer l’engagement des joueurs Casino, en veillant à la cohérence des dispositifs avec les objectifs de croissance. Suivre les résultats des campagnes à l’aide des principaux indicateurs de performance, préparer des synthèses et partager les enseignements utiles avec les équipes concernées. Participer à l’identification de pistes d’amélioration en croisant les performances observées, les retours des joueurs et les pratiques du marché. Contribuer à la construction et au suivi du calendrier des activations mensuelles, en coordonnant les étapes de préparation avec les équipes CRM, Design et marketing local. Accompagner la mise en avant des nouveaux jeux et fonctionnalités : préparation des supports, coordination des prises de parole et suivi des premiers résultats. Participer aux tests et à l’amélioration des parcours et outils marketing, puis documenter les éventuels ajustements nécessaires avant leur déploiement. Réaliser une veille sur les initiatives de croissance et les activations concurrentes afin d’alimenter les réflexions de l’équipe Casino. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons des étudiants passionnés et curieux, qui apportent bienveillance et enthousiasme à l’équipe. Ce stage est fait pour vous si: Vous préparez actuellement un Master en Business, Marketing ou Digital Marketing (ou équivalent). Vous avez au moins 6 mois d’expérience (stage, alternance) sur des fonctions digitales, e-commerce, start up (ou équivalent). Vous êtes curieux des technologies, plateformes et outils digitaux. Vous êtes organisé, motivé pour apprendre et proactif dans la résolution de problèmes. Vous êtes à l’aise avec Excel et motivé pour développer vos compétences sur les outils et plateformes marketing. Vous parlez français couramment et maitrisez l'anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit (obligatoire). WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 - Si votre candidature est retenue, Benoit, Talent Acquisition, vous contactera sous une semaine pour un premier échange de 30 minutes. - Vous rencontrerez ensuite Etienne, Casino Growth Manager et futur tuteur. - Puis, vous passerez le test AssessFirst (personnalité, motivation et raisonnement cognitif) avant un échange avec le reste de l’équipe. - Enfin, Benoit conduira un dernier entretien RH pour analyser ensemble les résultats AssessFirst. Le processus de recrutement dure en général entre 2 et 4 semaines afin de garantir la meilleure expérience possible. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 🍽️ Une carte Ticket Restaurant créditée de 11 euros par jour (6 euros pris en charge par Betclic) 🚆 60% de remboursement des transports en commun ou une prime annuelle de mobilité durable (230 euros pour les trajets en transport durable) 🏡 Un modèle de travail hybride 🏢 Des bureaux extraordinaires avec rooftop pour profiter de pauses ensoleillées face à la Cité du Vin 🎉 Des événements internes pour animer votre quotidien 🏋️ Des cours de sport et tournois organisés sur site (Pilates, circuit training, boxe, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Stage disponible à partir de janvier 2027 à Bordeaux. Un contrat d’apprentissage n’est pas possible sur ce rôle. Localisation: Bordeaux 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships Negotiator on the Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships team, you will drive the acquisition of premium content and negotiate complex agreements to secure high-value data and content for AI training, RAG, and distribution. Your work will enable Mistral AI to access quality, relevant sources while building long-term relationships with publishers, universities, research institutions, and data providers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align content sourcing with Mistral AI’s strategic interests, ensuring innovative and ethical use of data. This role is for a results-driven negotiator who thrives in high-stakes deal-making and understands the intersection of AI, academic content, and ethical data practices. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build and manage a pipeline of high-quality content (STEM, academic, robotics, multimedia) while vetting providers for legal and business compliance. - Negotiate complex, multi-pronged agreements (licensing, revenue-sharing, co-development) with publishers, universities, and research institutions. - Develop long-term partnerships that promote fair compensation and sustainability for content creators and owners. - Collaborate with internal teams (Science, Product, Go To Market) to align procurement with their objectives and evaluate "make vs. buy" options. - Provide regular reports and analytics on procurement activities to support data-driven decision-making. - Design programs that foster ethical and scalable content sourcing, balancing internal development with external licensing. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven track record negotiating and closing complex deals ($10M+), including licensing, revenue-sharing, or co-development agreements. - Deep understanding of AI training data ecosystems and the ability to translate technical needs into business terms. - Legal acumen in data acquisition and content licensing, including knowledge of global copyright laws. - Strong STEM background (degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field) and passion for academic content. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience negotiating with C-level stakeholders. - Business acumen in market analysis and financial modeling (e.g., DCF analysis). - Fluency in English and French; additional languages (e.g., German) are a plus. - Existing network in publishing, academic, or research communities or experience with AI training data (pretraining, RAG, synthetic data). WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.department: Institutional Sales, Trading, and Prime Services
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Prime Sales Trader on the Institutional Prime Trading team, you'll help grow one of Coinbase's most strategically important businesses by delivering best-in-class execution and liquidity solutions to the world's most sophisticated institutional clients. Our clients include asset managers, hedge funds, VCs, family offices, pensions, and endowments across both crypto-native and traditional finance. You'll drive trading volume, deepen counterparty relationships, and shape how institutional clients experience Coinbase's execution services across spot and derivatives markets. What you'll do: Drive increased trading volume by understanding clients' liquidity needs, proactively identifying how high-touch and low-touch execution services can meet those needs, and providing real-time support for execution and market color. Build and maintain trusted counterparty relationships through quality execution, daily market updates on liquidity and flow thematics, and consistent, high-quality service delivery. Partner with Sales, Financing, and Account Management teams to identify, onboard, and monetize new client relationships, proactively surfacing business opportunities across Coinbase's institutional product suite. Provide structured feedback from clients and the broader marketplace to institutional Product Managers, guiding new product development across spot trading and financing. Maintain a real-time pulse on market sentiment, trading activity, and client positioning, keeping relevant internal teams informed to support strategic decision-making. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of sales and/or trading experience in digital assets, FX, equities, credit, or derivatives at a top-tier institution, with direct experience in daily execution and settlement functions. Strong options trading capability, including pricing, hedging, and risk-managing vanilla and/or exotic structures, with fluency in Greeks, volatility dynamics, and options market microstructure. Proven ability to build and maintain counterparty relationships with institutional clients, translating market insight into trusted, high-value interactions. Experience producing institutional-grade market commentary or client communications covering macro, crypto, or digital asset themes. Weekend availability required - this role operates on a schedule that includes Saturday and Sunday as working days. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Growth Marketing, Creative and Ad Operations
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering. Our Growth Marketing team is a rapidly scaling functional area, accelerating growth by connecting out-of-product and in-product experiences into seamless journeys that acquire, retain, and re-engage users, unlocking ChatGPT’s transformative potential in users’ daily lives. We work cross-functionally with product, engineering, design, data science, finance, and marketing to unlock scalable growth levers and deliver measurable impact across diverse markets. This team thrives on rapid testing, rigorous measurement, and creative problem solving, all while keeping user value at the center of our decision-making. ABOUT THE ROLE In this role, you will build and run the creative and advertising operations system that powers OpenAI’s paid marketing programs. You will connect Creative and Growth Marketing teams, establish clear processes for producing and launching high-quality ads, and keep the operational details behind paid campaigns organized, accurate, and scalable. You will help translate growth priorities into creative briefs and testing roadmaps, coordinate assets and approvals across internal teams and external partners, and turn performance results into clear next steps. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build and manage the end-to-end paid creative operating system, including creative intake, briefing, production, asset delivery, approvals, trafficking, launch, reporting, and iteration. - Serve as the day-to-day connector between Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, agencies, and production partners, keeping priorities and timelines clear and on track. - Partner with Growth Marketing to build and maintain creative testing roadmaps, translating campaign goals, audience insights, and performance data into briefs, hypotheses, test plans, and clear success metrics. - Develop and maintain the tools and processes that keep creative production organized, including asset libraries, production calendars, naming conventions, tagging, version control, specifications, and documentation. - Track creative test results, document learnings, and partner with Growth Marketing and Creative to identify what is working, what needs to change, and what should be tested next. - Continuously improve workflows, templates, reporting, and automation to increase creative throughput, reduce errors, and make paid marketing operations more efficient and reliable. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - 7+ years of experience in creative operations, growth or performance marketing, integrated marketing, or a related role supporting paid marketing programs. - Exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor, with a track record of owning high precision work in either creative or campaign operations. - Experience building or improving creative production workflows, project trackers, asset libraries, approval processes, and other systems that help teams execute consistently. - Hands-on familiarity with major paid advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, or LinkedIn, including campaign trafficking, asset requirements, and launch QA. - Working knowledge of marketing tracking and measurement, including UTMs, pixels, conversion events, platform reporting, and basic campaign or creative performance analysis. - Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, keep stakeholders aligned, surface risks early, and follow through on details. - Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to turn growth priorities into actionable briefs, testing plans, and next steps. - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment and a proactive, resourceful approach to solving problems; experience with billing, invoicing, vendor management, or workflow automation is a plus. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Growth Marketing Manager
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. About Kalshi Kalshi is building the next generation of financial markets — where people can trade on what they think will happen. From economic events to cultural trends, Kalshi lets traders take positions on real-world outcomes. Our mission is to make trading events as natural and intuitive as trading stocks. We’re growing fast and looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to help scale our user acquisition and engagement engine. You’ll own experimentation across digital channels, optimize the user funnel, and help turn curiosity into active trading. If you’re obsessed with performance data, creative testing, and building growth systems from the ground up, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own paid acquisition across channels like Google, Meta, YouTube, affiliates, and influencer partnerships — driving efficient growth and lowering CAC. Test, learn, and scale — run continuous experiments across creatives, landing pages, and audience segments to improve signups and first-trade conversion. Partner cross-functionally with product, lifecycle, and data teams to optimize onboarding and retention flows. Develop high-impact campaigns that connect real-world events to trading opportunities on Kalshi. Analyze performance across every stage of the funnel — from awareness through deposit and trade — and build strategies that move the needle. Report on growth metrics to leadership with clear insights and recommendations for budget allocation and scaling decisions. Move fast. We test ideas weekly and double down on what works. What You’ll Bring 6+ years in growth or performance marketing , ideally in fintech, consumer trading, or high-growth tech managing large budgets. Deep experience managing digital acquisition programs (paid search, social, programmatic, affiliates, or influencers). Strong understanding of user funnels, attribution, and experimentation frameworks . Experience with A/B Testing and lift measurement. SQL knowledge. Analytical mindset — comfortable digging into data to diagnose performance and find leverage points. Experience working with creative, data, and product teams to drive measurable results. A bias for action — you’re resourceful, fast, and thrive on solving ambiguous growth problems. Nice to Have Experience working with AI in marketing context. Experience marketing to retail investors or active traders Familiarity with event-driven trading or prediction markets . Comfort working in a regulated or compliance-driven environment. Interest in financial markets, news, and real-world events. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. About the Role We’re looking for a Partnerships Manager focused on social media to help Kalshi break into culture and scale through partnerships with the right creators, influencers, and media accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying great partners, building relationships, negotiating smart deals, and launching high-impact campaigns that resonate across social platforms. This role can span multiple channels - X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, and more - and is perfect for someone who is deeply immersed in internet culture and knows how to spot what’s about to go viral. What You’ll Do Scout & Source: Identify creators, influencers, and accounts that align with Kalshi’s mission and voice. Build & Negotiate: Initiate conversations, cultivate relationships, and secure impactful deals. Launch Campaigns: Partner with creators to roll out activations that drive reach, virality, and user growth. Experiment Across Platforms: Test partnerships on different channels and double down on what works. Track & Optimize: Measure performance, report results, and continuously refine partnership strategies. Who’s a Good Fit Chronically online. You’re plugged into internet culture 24/7 and know where trends start. Well-connected. You’ve got a rolodex of creators or know how to reach them fast. Virality radar. You can instinctively tell what will catch fire online. Deal-maker. You’re comfortable structuring partnerships that balance creativity with business value. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap We are building a novel asset class while scaling up a marketplace for people to trade it (the exchange). As with all meaningful inventions, mass adoption requires value prop refining, education, and trust building. Scaling a new asset class requires both creativity (art) and hardcore discipline (science). We are building our growth team, a cross-functional team of artists and scientists to tackle the uncharted territory of scaling events trading. As one of the first dedicated performance marketers on the team, you'll help shape and structure our paid growth strategy by refinding and iterating our value props and messaging in. We are an incredibly content-rich platform: we have over 500 markets and a market for any trending topic out there (Sam Altman leaving OpenAI, Fed cutting rates, Oscars, Biden Approbal, etc.). We are looking to build a dynamic growth machine that capitalizes on trends and viral markets on a weekly basis. Your responsibilities will include: Lead, iterate, run, and maintain all paid growth efforts, including FB/Instagram, Twitter, and Tiktok Run our AdWords bidding strategy (with a goal to improve our SEO) Establish disciplined end-to-end tracking for our funnel based on different channels Improve customer attribution and refine our understanding of customer segments Test and iterate on our messaging and value props Efficiently scale and manage our paid spend budget (5 to 7 figures) Develop creatives and visuals in collaboration with design Create market-specific campaigns targeted at the right audiences (economics, Oscars, tech, AI, etc.) Leverage AI to develop personalized campaigns (why not) Be bold, make big bets, and have fun. Who You Are A scientist at heart who is maniacally disciplined and obsessive about experimenting. A big plus if you're also creative and have crazy ideas. You'll thrive in this role if you deeply care about what you produce, you want ownership and freedom (we're low on process and BS politics), know how to be scrappy and finesse your way around the world, and thrive in a (ridiculously) fast-paced environment. Some other basic requirements: 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role (this is not necessary) Proven track record of driving growth and user acquisition for online products Strong analytical skills and data fluency Proficient with Facebook/Instagram, Google, Twitter, and Tiktok Excellent judgment on task prioritizations Growth mindset, with a high slope and eagerness to lean Love of the craft: you genuinely care and put your all into your work Can ship at incredible speed (very simple) Bonus: have worked in the gaming industry before. These are the primary responsibilities of the role; however, there is endless green field at Kalshi: if you're ambitious and bold, it's yours to take. NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure: Salary Range: $100,000 to $200,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but a broad range of experience is represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further. Our Culture Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.title: Legal Specialist, Law Enforcement
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are looking for a hands-on Legal Specialist (Law Enforcement) to join our Litigation, Regulatory & Policy team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a key player in building out our legal function and running how Anthropic responds to law enforcement and government requests for user data, while navigating the intricate regulatory landscape of the AI industry. We expect this role to flex beyond the law enforcement queue into legal operations to support the broader litigation, regulatory, and policy team. The successful candidate will be a strong team player, able to build positive relationships with colleagues and work collaboratively toward shared goals. Key responsibilities Own the end-to-end response to law enforcement and government requests for user data, from intake and validation through production and closeout, including subpoenas, court orders, search warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests from domestic and foreign authorities Prepare and execute data productions: scoping, data retrieval, coordination with counsel, and eventual production Handle foreign and cross-border process, including MLATs and letters rogatory, and manage escalations across jurisdictions Handle civil third-party subpoenas and preservation demands Maintain expertise in where user data lives across Anthropic's product surfaces and operate the internal data retrieval tooling Run and improve the law enforcement response process and tooling Partner with Trust and Safety, Security, Privacy, and Engineering on requests that touch user accounts, investigations, or safety escalations Coordinate with outside counsel, alongside in-house counsel, on objections, challenges, and narrowing Produce recurring reporting on request volume, deadlines, and queue health, and support Anthropic's periodic transparency reporting on government requests Monitor legal developments in government access to user data and advise the team on their operational impact Support litigation and regulatory matters and stretch beyond core responsibilities as needed to support the legal team's objectives Minimum qualifications Experience in a legal operations, business/operations manager, or paralegal role in an in-house legal department, or similar experience Direct, front-line experience handling law enforcement or government requests for user data, including subpoenas, court orders, warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests Working knowledge of the legal framework for law enforcement access to user data, including the Stored Communications Act and the mechanics of foreign and cross-border requests such as MLATs Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment and maintain the highest standards of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive legal matters, including under time pressure Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously Experience owning an intake, queue, or docketing process end to end, including deciding what gets escalated and maintaining rigorous tracking Comfort operating and improving the tooling a legal process runs on (trackers, spreadsheets, forms, aliases, and simple automations), with a willingness to make changes directly rather than route every change to someone else A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying, recommending, and implementing process improvements within the legal department Preferred qualifications 5+ years of experience in legal operations, business/operations management, or a paralegal role in an in-house legal department 2+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company, with exposure to the legal challenges and opportunities presented by emerging technologies Experience building or scaling a law enforcement response process Experience managing legal intake process within a growing company Demonstrated ability to think critically and creatively, adapting to new challenges and finding practical solutions to complex legal issues Familiarity with legal project management software such as Asana, Trello, or Jira, and a willingness to learn and adopt new tools to streamline legal processes The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $1 — $2 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We believe powerful AI can compress a century of scientific progress into a decade. Bringing Claude to scientists and engineers is a big part of building toward that future. Claude has already helped uncover a novel enzyme system , formalize Fermat’s Last Theorem , design more efficient quantum circuits , and compute new results in theoretical physics — and this is just the beginning. You’ll figure out what scientists and engineers need from Claude and build it from 0→1. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As an Inbound Specialist II, you'll join the Customer Experience team as a frontline specialist supporting Coinbase's highest-value customers, including High Net Worth and Ultra High Net Worth segments. You'll own inbound customer interactions across multiple channels, resolving complex issues with speed and accuracy while building trusted relationships that strengthen retention and satisfaction. What you'll do: Own inbound support for Premium and Wealth customers across phone, messaging, and email, investigating and resolving complex issues through to completion on first contact wherever possible. Build trusted, long-term relationships with high-value customers by proactively identifying needs, following up on open items, and guiding them to features and products that match their profile. Partner with Compliance, Risk, and cross-functional teams to navigate account issues within a regulated, non-advisory framework while maintaining fast and accurate resolution times. Drive root-cause analysis by leveraging customer data and feedback to surface defects, reduce friction, and improve the end-to-end customer experience. Develop and maintain deep expertise in Coinbase products, blockchain fundamentals, and the evolving crypto landscape to serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Premium and Wealth customers. Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex customer issues across multiple channels (phone, email, messaging) in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Working knowledge of blockchain, cryptocurrency, staking, self-custody, or digital assets, as well as traditional financial products such as equities, fixed income, or wealth management services. Professional proficiency in at least one language beyond English, written and verbal. Willingness to work flexible schedules, including nights and weekends, to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets. items.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. More accuracy. More agency. More signal, less noise. Our answer engine handles hundreds of millions of queries every month for people whose questions spark change and whose decisions bend the world toward progress. Our legal team works side by side with product and business teams. We help the company move quickly, make sound risk decisions, and build legal requirements into products and operations from the start. About the Opportunity We are looking for a practical, versatile attorney to join our Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal team. You will have a clear center of gravity in consumer protection and a flexible mandate across product counseling, privacy, regulatory matters, marketing, subscriptions, and international expansion. This is not a narrow subject matter role. You might advise on a new consumer product flow one day, assess an advertising or subscription practice the next, and help respond to a regulator or customer escalation after that. You will work directly with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Support, Security, GRC, Policy, and Communications. The right person can identify the legal issue quickly, learn the product deeply, and give the business a practical path forward. You will own matters independently and help turn recurring questions into clear guidance and durable systems. This role Reports to the Senior Director, Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal. What You Will Do - Serve as a primary legal partner for consumer products and features from early design through launch and post-launch review - Advise on consumer protection issues, including unfair and deceptive practices, disclosures, pricing, subscriptions, renewals, refunds, promotions, advertising claims, dark patterns, and customer support practices - Review marketing, growth, and advertising initiatives, including adtech and martech integrations, audience practices, email and messaging campaigns, and product claims - Counsel product and engineering teams on privacy, data use, consent, retention, security, AI transparency, age-related protections, and other legal requirements - Lead legal review of cross-functional launches and translate complex requirements into practical product and operational choices - Support responses to consumer complaints, state attorneys general, competition authorities, privacy authorities, and other regulators around the world, in partnership with the regulatory lead and outside counsel - Assess incidents and escalations that cross product, privacy, consumer protection, contractual, and regulatory lines - Monitor legal developments affecting AI products and online services, then convert them into clear advice, playbooks, and product requirements - Help build scalable legal infrastructure, including templates, review standards, decision records, training, and self-service guidance - Flex across the broader Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risk change What We Are Looking For - J.D. from an accredited law school, or an LL.M. or equivalent law degree, and current authorization to practice law in the U.S. state where you are located - At least five years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, government agency, or in house, with meaningful consumer protection or product counseling experience - Strong command of U.S. consumer protection law and enforcement principles, including Section 5 of the FTC Act and state unfair or deceptive acts and practices (UDAP) laws - Experience with several of the following areas: subscriptions and auto-renewal, advertising and marketing, privacy and data protection, payments, promotions, platform regulation, or AI governance - Ability to lead a product or regulatory matter independently, from fact development through recommendation and execution - Excellent judgment. You know what to decide, what to escalate, and how to explain risk without slowing the business unnecessarily - Clear, direct writing and the ability to translate legal requirements for product, engineering, and business teams - Comfort learning technical systems and asking precise questions about how products, data flows, and controls actually work - Hands-on attitude, low ego, intellectual curiosity, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment - Genuine interest in AI products and the legal questions created by how people use them Bonus - Experience at the FTC, a state attorney general's office, or another consumer protection or privacy regulator - In-house experience at a consumer technology company, online platform, marketplace, or subscription business - Experience handling regulator inquiries, investigations, or consumer class action risk - Working knowledge of the CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, state privacy laws, ROSCA, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, COPPA, state auto-renewal laws, or similar international consumer regimes

items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, US - Remote
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations including universities and other educational institutions, helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. - Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria. - Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution. - Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Experience navigating education or research environments, including institutional data, privacy, access controls and complex integrations, is valuable. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives. - Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. Experience working with education institutions, particularly universities, is preferred but not required. Prior OpenAI product experience is not required. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations within the Healthcare and Life Sciences segment (HLS), helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. You will work across clinical, operational, administrative and research workflows, translating security, privacy and governance requirements into practical deployment decisions. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. - Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria. - Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution. - Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback. - Partner with customer security, privacy, clinical and business teams to design responsible AI deployments, including data handling, access controls, evaluation, human oversight and monitoring. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Have experience delivering AI or software in healthcare, life sciences or similarly complex regulated enterprises, with measurable outcomes beyond a proof of concept and familiarity with sensitive data, legacy systems and interoperability. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives. - Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity. - Healthcare or life sciences experience is strongly preferred; strong candidates from other regulated enterprise environments are also encouraged to apply. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. You’ll design and run rigorous, exploratory and requirements-driven tests—building custom test equipment, analyzing results, and translating findings into actionable insights that drive design breakthroughs and mitigate risks across hardware and software. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence how our AI scales beyond simulation, ensuring that every design, test, and iteration brings us closer to truly adaptive, versatile robotic systems.
